interface.title: qPCR Analyzer v2.3.0
interface.field: Molecular biology: RT-qPCR gene expression analysis
interface.stage_of_work: Data analysis: from a raw per-well Ct/Cq export to normalised relative-expression tables, plots and exported files
interface.what_it_is_for: A seven-step guided workflow that turns a per-well qPCR results file into replicate-QC'd, housekeeping-normalised ΔCt and batch-aware ΔΔCt relative expression, with live tabs for summary, plots and downloads.

data.note: mock_qpcr_384well.csv (12.5 KB, 384 rows × 5 columns: Well, Target, Sample, Cq, Group). It has 16 samples (Ctrl_1–5, TreatA_1–5, TreatB_1–6), 8 targets (EZH2, SUZ12, DNMT1, TET2, KDM6A, BRD4, GAPDH, ACTB), 3 groups and 4 NA Cq wells. The summary reported 128 replicate blocks at '3–3 replicates/block', so no sextuplicates were seen. The file has no Batch column. To exercise the batch-aware path I turned batches on and moved Ctrl_5, TreatA_5 and TreatB_6 to batch_2.

tree.general: Turn raw per-well threshold cycle (Ct/Cq) values into normalised relative gene expression across experimental groups, and export it
tree.specific: Go from a 384-well Ct export to housekeeping-normalised ΔCt and Control-anchored ΔΔCt bar plots, Excel/CSV and PNGs

features.name: Auto-detected column-role mapper with completeness check
features.general: Upload a table, have each required role (ID, feature, sample, value, optional group/batch) matched to a column with a confidence badge, correct any mapping from dropdowns, and see per-role fill rates before going on
features.specific: Step 2 Column mapping: Well/Target/Sample/Cq/Group/Batch dropdowns with 'match · 100%' badges and a Data completeness box (Cq 380/384 99%)
steps: Upload file
Review auto-matched dropdown per role and its match badge
Change or set an optional role (e.g. Batch) to (none) or a column
Read the completeness chips and press Continue
serves_tasks: Confirm which columns hold which roles

features.name: Editable sample-to-group/batch assignment table
features.general: List every unique sample with editable combo-box cells for its group and batch. Typing a new value and pressing Enter adds it to the choices, and a toggle switches between single-batch and multi-batch mode
features.specific: Step 3 Groups & batches: checkbox 'Samples are from different batches', with per-sample Group and Batch comboboxes (e.g. type batch_2 + Enter). Batch then shows in Data preview and Summary
steps: Tick the multi-batch checkbox
Click a sample's Batch (or Group) cell
Type a new value and press Enter, or pick an existing one
Watch out: if the cell's dropdown is open, Enter picks the highlighted option instead of the typed value
Continue; the Batch column now appears in the preview and summary
serves_tasks: Assign each sample to a group and, if needed, a batch

features.name: Replicate outlier exclusion with tolerance rule, chip list and block-context view
features.general: Within each set of technical replicates, keep the tightest run within a tolerance and flag the rest. Manually add or remove items from the exclusion list, and review each affected replicate set in full with ok/outlier/excluded status
features.specific: Step 4 Outliers: Replicate tolerance (cycles) + Apply tolerance, plus a 'Wells to exclude from analysis' chip multiselect. The Excluded blocks tab lists Sample × Target blocks with Well/Cq/Status and 'n excluded · n flagged of 3'
steps: Read the Outlier rule explanation
Enter a tolerance (press Enter to commit) and press Apply tolerance
Inspect blocks on the Excluded blocks tab
Remove a chip to keep a flagged well (status → outlier)
Type a well ID in the picker to exclude it manually
serves_tasks: Flag inconsistent replicates automatically with a tolerance rule

features.name: Multi-reference-gene picker with per-gene and global sample exclusion
features.general: Choose one or more reference features to normalise against. Optionally drop samples for one reference only or for all of them, then lock the choice with Apply while a side panel summarises sample- and well-level exclusions
features.specific: Step 5 Housekeeping gene(s): multiselect (GAPDH, ACTB), 'Samples to exclude for <gene>' dropdowns, 'Exclude entirely' dropdown, and Apply. The Housekeeping & exclusions tab shows Status applied, a Sample exclusion summary and a Well exclusion summary (Wells by sample × target)
steps: Pick one or more housekeeping genes
Optionally pick samples to exclude for a specific gene or for all genes
Press Apply (status changes from pending to applied)
Review sample and well exclusion summaries
Continue to ΔCt
serves_tasks: Choose one or more reference genes and per-gene sample exclusions

features.name: Batch-aware reference-group fold-change (ΔΔCt) with re-anchoring
features.general: Pick a reference condition, compute each sample's value relative to that condition's mean within its own batch, and redraw the grouped bar plots. Re-run with another reference to re-anchor
features.specific: Step 7: 'Reference group (ΔΔCt anchor)' dropdown (Control/TreatmentA/TreatmentB) showing '2 batch(es): batch_1, batch_2', then Run ΔΔCt. The ΔΔCt results tab shows 2^(−ΔΔCt) with the anchor at 1
steps: Choose the reference group
Check the listed batches (each must contain the reference group)
Press Run ΔΔCt
Inspect the ΔΔCt results bar plots
Change the reference and run again
serves_tasks: Compute fold change relative to a chosen reference group, within each batch
Repeat the fold-change calculation against a different reference group

features.name: Per-target grouped bar-plot grid with replicate points
features.general: For each measured feature, show group-mean bars with error bars and individual sample points. Hover a point for its sample and value, box-drag to zoom, double-click to reset, and save any single panel as PNG
features.specific: ΔCt / ΔΔCt results tabs: 'EZH2 / GAPDH' style panels per housekeeping gene, with tooltips like 'TreatmentA TreatA_5 val = 0.030' and a modebar (camera, zoom, pan, reset); the check run saved a single panel as newplot.png with the camera icon
steps: Open the ΔCt or ΔΔCt results tab
Hover a point to read sample and value
Drag a box to zoom, double-click to reset
Scroll to the next housekeeping gene's panel set
Press a panel's camera icon to save that single plot as a PNG
serves_tasks: Compute reference-normalised expression for every target
Compute fold change relative to a chosen reference group, within each batch
Download a combined figure for publication

features.name: Results export panel (workbook, CSV bundle, combined figures)
features.general: Export all raw and computed tables as one multi-sheet workbook or a zip of CSVs, and save a combined multi-panel figure per normalisation reference
features.specific: Downloads tab: Download XLSX (raw, dCt_*, ddCt_*, formatted_* sheets), Download CSV (ZIP), and expandable Combined ΔCt / ΔΔCt plots per housekeeping gene, each with a camera icon
steps: Open the Downloads tab
Press Download XLSX
Press Download CSV (ZIP)
Expand a combined plot (e.g. ΔΔCt · GAPDH)
Press its camera icon to save the PNG
serves_tasks: Download tables of raw and computed results
Download a combined figure for publication

features.name: Dataset overview panel with count chips and expandable lists
features.general: Summarise a loaded dataset as count chips (records, missing values, replicate sets, replicates per set) plus expandable lists of samples, features, groups and batches that update as annotations change
features.specific: Summary tab: Wells 384, NA Cq 4, Replicate blocks 128, Replicates/block 3–3, and expandable Samples: 16, Targets: 8, Groups: 3 rows; a Batches: 2 row appears once batches are set
steps: Open the Summary tab
Read the count chips
Expand a list (e.g. Targets: 8) to see its members
After assigning batches, expand Batches to check them

features.name: Sorted, block-shaded data preview table with paging
features.general: Show the standardised records in a fixed sort order, shade rows by replicate set so each set reads as one unit, and page through the records
features.specific: Data preview tab: 'Standardised data — sorted by Target (file order) → Group → Sample → Well', columns Well/Target/Group/Sample/Batch/Cq, shading alternating by replicate block, pagination buttons and a Records per page dropdown
steps: Open the Data preview tab
Read the sort order in the header
Scan rows, using the shading to tell replicate blocks apart
Page through with the pagination buttons (e.g. last page)
